findings.title: Static config seeding has no regression coverage
findings.description: The new first-run path searches for a static config, parses it or falls back to defaults, then persists the result to app data. No tests exercise these outcomes (or the existing-config branch against the new behavior), so regressions in discovering, parsing, or persisting the seed would go unnoticed. The repository has no test files and package.json defines no test script.

findings.title: Browser ignores the settings file that Tauri syncs
findings.description: After a desktop save with an API key, `sync_to_static` deliberately writes an empty `elevenlabs_api_key` while syncing voices and preferences. A browser session with no localStorage config therefore rejects that file here and falls through to defaults, so the documented desktop-to-browser settings sync no longer loads those settings. Accepting the synced preferences while preserving any local key, or emitting a separate marker, would avoid discarding the whole file.
